en: Tell me what drives this vengeance?
More bones to gnaw on...
We have excess supplies, but not many.  We'll need a lot more before we can send a ground assault into the Field of Strife.
Let's see if the fish are biting.
Ah, beautiful Menethil Harbor, with the best mead this side of Ironforge.
I am here for training.
Edward, ya leadin' us off. Git in there.
%s is fully grown!
Stalagg crush you!
I serve to the last!
I suspect that the imps are stealing knowledge.
Duke of Shards! I hold your signet!  Heed my call!
The fortune is mine, Alexi! Your end comes soon!
%s roars furiously.
DIE!
Welcome to the Cenarion Circle, $c.
Doh!

What Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol did not realize was that just as their servants were bound to the land, so would they be... You see, the price for their own immortality was also imprisonment and eternal servitude under the command of Razelikh. The cruel cunning of Razelikh had emerged the victor once again.
Argh, I need help here!

I am Samuel Hawke, the main supplier for the League of Arathor posted here at Arathi Basin.  As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.
Hakkar shall live again!
Innkeeper Norman on upper ring of Trade Quarter is one to talk to.
Ahh, "Mystical Conjurings of the Archmages of Dalaran." Perfect.
It worked!  Amazing!  I guess I haven't lost my touch...

Oh, hello there!  I'm Hol'anyee, the chief scientist and biologist of Marshal Expeditions.  My brother and I, along with our companions, travel Azeroth exploring the wild and untamed majesty.  It is exciting... but, um... I think we got ourselves into a little too much excitement this time!

It does my soul good to see the walls of Stormwind standing strong and tall.$b$bIf you're looking to go to Stratholme, I'm afraid I'm unable to assist at the moment. The towers nearby the burning city are still in contention, and as such my powers are far too weak to aid you. Return to me once you're victorious there.
I have a piece of iron in my back that will remind me of that night for the rest of my days.
Raiders from the northwest! Fire!
Ah, here we are!  Well let's get to work, shall we...?
The Soulflayer is defeated!  Our leader, Molthor, now calls more of his servants...
How dare you enter my sanctum!
Be bathed in my power! Drink in my might! Battle for the glory of the Horde!
I can teach you the finer points of Wolf Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
Paval Reethe! Found you at last. And consorting with ogres now? No fear, even deserters and traitors are afforded some mercy.
Now's not a good time, $n.$B$BAre you insane?!
Thank you for rescuing me! Word of your deed will not go unnoticed.
Balance has been restored!
Scourge inside Trade Quarter!  Destroy!
Your skill displays an enduring affection for our art, but I would see further evidence of your commitment. I shall charge you with a task. Fulfill it, and I will be content.
Astounding. You managed to dominate her, yet she retains self awareness and function. How did you do it?
The Iceblood Graveyard was taken by the Alliance!
Arathi Basin place to take from soft humans.  Sir Malory Wheeler send you there.
Blue plus red... I predict...
After the savagery that my people have witnessed and felt, you expect me to accept another burden, dragon? Surely you are mad.
Uh oh! My tools' have run out. We're going to have to start over...
